name: BSP_ShipAi_SetDesiredHeading
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_cruise_command, read-only analysis. __thiscall(state, float), RET 4, body 009E0040-009E0095, complete apart from 009DA4E0 and 00605070. blk = [state]+8; when blk+1C4h is not 1 it zeroes blk+360h and blk+368h and sets blk+1C4h to 1, then calls 009DA4E0(blk), stores the argument UNCLAMPED at blk+1D8h, calls 00605070 with ECX = blk+1D8h and clears blk+1CCh. docs/CRUISE_COMMAND.md

name: BSP_ShipAi_CruiseStateStep
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_cruise_command, read-only analysis. __fastcall(state), RET 4, body 009E1170-009E14B7. vtable[0Ch] of the AI state class at 00D21598, whose vtable[24h] is 009DAC20 (MOV EAX,0xE08F70; RET), so this is the cruise state. AI arm 009E1265..009E13B1: throttle from 008356F0 (cruiseThrust), overridden by *(unit+73Ch)+24h / 0080FC30 when *(unit+73Ch)+28h >= 0; then 008356C0 selects 009DFFB0(cruiseSteerOrHeading) or, when moving (|throttle| > 0.05 at 00D7A270 or |0092D730| > 1.0f), 009E0040(cruiseSteerOrHeading), else 009DFFB0(0); 009DBF90(throttle) closes both arms. docs/CRUISE_COMMAND.md | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2l: the AI arm 009e1265..009e13b1 ran 3480 times, once per fixed simulation step over the 12 latched ships that are not the controlled unit. The commanded-speed override at 009e12ac was never taken, because *(unit+73ch)+28h carries the -1.0f that disables it and no producer writes +24h; with cruiseIsHeading set and both a zero thrust and a zero body-axis speed the rule took the straight arm at 009e1350 every step. Nothing it decided reached a ring: 009dbf90 / 009dffb0 / 009e0040 write the AI controller block at [state]+8 and the hop from that block to unit+0fc4h / unit+0fdch under the unit+61h gate has no recovered writer. The controlled unit takes the player arm at 009e11e8 instead, which is recorded rather than projected.

evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet unit_command_producers, read-only analysis. float10 __thiscall(this, float, float, float), unit at this+3FCh, caller 009F3F80. Folds five BSP_Math_InterpolateClamped stages over the tuning block 00424C40 (+6CCh, +6D0h, +6D4h, +6E0h, +6E4h, +6E8h, +6ECh), clamps the result into the band around the unit's own +980h at 009EC93C, then against [unit+73Ch]+24h divided by this+3C4h when [unit+73Ch]+28h is not negative, and negates it unless this+364h is set, returning -0.625f (00D21A78) below the floor -0.625 (00D21A80). name: BSP_ShipAi_ControlsStep
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_ai_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall(blk)(float seconds), RET 4, body 009ED6B0-009EF228, called at 009F5209. Turns the control block's desired throttle/rudder/heading (+1D0h/+1D4h/+1D8h under the mode at +1C4h) into the heading target +324h and the two distances +32Ch/+330h that 009F4D10 publishes. 009ED6B0-009EDA25, the direct-control arm for modes 0 and 1, is reconstructed as ship_ai_direct_control_arm_009ed6b0; 009EDA26-009EF228, the navigation arm that computes a bearing to a waypoint, is read in pseudocode only. docs/SHIP_AI_STATES.md | Packet cc_ai_order_hop: the navigation arm's output block 009EE671..009EEAA2 is now read from the listing and reconstructed as ship_ai_navigation_arm_009ee671 / ship_ai_turn_lead_009ee848 in src/ship_ai_navigation.cpp. It writes blk+32Ch = the planar distance to the path point (009EE770), blk+324h = the bearing to it (009EE818) corrected by a distance-tapered turn lead (009EE848..009EE9D8), and blk+330h = the remaining path length (009EEA00), plus the look-ahead radius blk+340h (009EEAA2). The block runs for blk+1C4h == 2 only: 009EE756 skips it while the mode is 3. 009EDA26..009EE670 and 009EEAAB..009EF228 stay unread. docs/SHIP_AI_NAVIGATION_ARM.md
